जल् I. €1 P. (जलति)
—1 To be rich or wealthy.
—2 To cover, hide, screen.
—3 To cover (as with a net), encircle, entangle.
—4 To be sharp.
—5 To be cold, stiff, dull, or dumb. ━II. €10 P. (जालयति) To cover, screen &c.

जल a. [जल् अच् डस्य लो वा]
—1 Dull, cold, frigid = जड q. v. —2 Stupid, idiotic.

—3 The embryo or uterus of a cow.

जल + -अञ्चलम्
—1 a spring.
—2 a natural water-course.
—3 moss.

जल + -अञ्जलिः

—2 a libation of water presented to the manes of a deceased person; कुपुत्रमासाद्य

जल + -अर्कः the image of the sun reflected in water.

जल + -अर्णवः

जलाष + -भेषज a. possessed of healing medicines; रुद्रं जलाषभेषजम् Rv. 1. 43. 4.

जल्प् €1 P.
 (जल्पति, जल्पित) —1 To speak, talk, speak or converse (with
 another); अविरलितकपोलं जल्पतोरक्रमेण U. 1. 27; एकेन जल्पन्त्यनल्पाक्षरम्
 Pt. 1. 136; Bh. 1. 82.
—2 To murmur, speak inarticulately.
—3 To chatter, prattle, babble.
—4 To praise.

जल्पः [जल्प् भावे घञ्]
—1 Talk, speech.
—2 Discourse, conversation.
—3 Babble, prattling, gossip;
—4 Debate, wrangling discussion.

—3 Cunning, deceptive (मायाविन्).

—2 A fowler, bird-catcher.
—3 A spider.
—4 The governor or chief ruler of a province.

जालन्धरः N. of a country in the north-west of India, the territory

जाल्म a. (-ल्मी f.)
—1 Cruel, severe, harsh.
—2 Rash, inconsiderate.

जाल्म + .{@-ल्मः@} (-ल्मी f.)
—1 A rogue, rascal, villain, wretch, miscreant; आस्तां जाल्म उदरं स्रंसयित्वा
 Av. 4. 16. 7; अपि ज्ञायते कतमेन दिग्भागेन गतः स जाल्म इति V. 1.
—2 A poor man, a low or degraded man.
—3 One who reads or recites badly; cf. P. VI. 2. 158.
